transactions.description: Live transactions with at least one source of this kind

lastAt.description: When a source of this kind last reached the ledger

items.description: Every listed kind, in that order, zero when unused

messageKey.description: smsMessageKey(): SHA-256 hex of sender, receive time and the parsed fields (never the body); makes resends no-ops

occurredAt.description: A row more than a day in the future is counted as rejected

timePrecision.description: "day" when the SMS named an earlier day than it arrived on

last4.description: Last 4 (or 3) digits of the account or card

narration.description: A short keyword for the type rules (UPI, CARD, ATM WITHDRAWAL, REFUND); never message text

merged.description: Matched a transaction already in the ledger (a statement row, an entry) and added this source to it

rejected.description: Refused one by one (invalid, or dated more than a day ahead); the rest of the batch still went in

system.description: System categories cannot be renamed or deleted

bankDetected.description: Bank named in the file, if any

newCount.description: Rows not in the ledger yet

duplicateCount.description: Rows already in the ledger (merged on confirm, never added twice)

flaggedCount.description: Possible duplicates and balance mismatches to look at

needsCategoryCount.description: New debit rows no rule could categorize

selectedCount.description: Rows that will be added: ticked and new

error.description: Why parsing failed: IMPORT_UNREADABLE, IMPORT_NO_ROWS, IMPORT_TOO_MANY_ROWS, IMPORT_PDF_SCANNED, IMPORT_PASSWORD_PROTECTED (unlock it with the password) or IMPORT_FAILED

alreadyImportedAt.description: Set when this exact file was imported before

balanceMismatch.description: The running balance doesn't add up at this row

password.description: The statement PDF's password. Used once to open the file; never stored or logged.

idToken.description: Google ID token from the app

deviceId.description: Stable per-install id, created on first launch

refreshToken.description: Single-use; swap it at /auth/refresh before the access token expires

clientRequestId.description: Made by the app when the Add sheet opens; a retry with the same id returns the same transaction

occurredAt.description: No more than one day in the future

categoryId.description: Omit to let the rules decide (Income for credits, Other for debits)

amountPaise.description: Always positive; direction gives the sign

userEdited.description: The user changed amount, date or merchant; later sources never overwrite it

amountPaise.description: Always positive; direction gives the sign

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last page

dayTotals.description: Totals for every IST day on this page, over all rows matching the filters

ids.description: Category ids the user picked most recently, newest first

applyToMerchant.description: Also move other rows from this merchant and remember it for new ones

updatedCount.description: Other transactions from the same merchant that moved too

spendPaise.description: Spend in paise, refunds already taken off

refundPaise.description: Refunds in the month (already taken off spend)

leftToSpendPaise.description: Monthly income − spend; negative when over; null without an income

usedPercent.description: Spend as a whole percent of monthly income

byCategory.description: Every category with spend, largest first

hasAnyTransactions.description: False until the user has any transaction at all (Home empty state)

start.description: First IST day of the bucket

dailyTargetPaise.description: Target ÷ saving days, rounded up to a whole rupee

suggestedTodayPaise.description: What to save today to stay on plan

scheduleDelta.description: Days ahead (positive) or behind (negative) of plan

newMilestones.description: Milestones this contribution reached, to celebrate

BudgetState.description: warning from 80%, over once spend passes the budget; a fixed budget paid in full is ok

spentPaise.description: Spend in the category this month, refunds taken off

usedPercent.description: Whole percent of the budget used, rounded down

state.description: warning from 80%, over once spend passes the budget; a fixed budget paid in full is ok

projectedPaise.description: Month-end spend at this pace; null in the first days or for past months

overshootPaise.description: How far over the budget the pace points; 0 when on track

AllowanceBasis.description: income: from the monthly income; budgets: the sum of budgets, when there is no income

allowancePaise.description: What can be spent today and still end the month on plan

leftTodayPaise.description: allowance − spent today; negative when over

daysLeft.description: Days left in the month, today included

basis.description: income: from the monthly income; budgets: the sum of budgets, when there is no income

fixedReservePaise.description: Fixed budgets held back this month

goalReservePaise.description: What active goals ask to be put aside this month

items.description: Fixed budgets last, then by most used

totalSpentPaise.description: Spend in budgeted categories this month

unbudgetedSpentPaise.description: Spend this month in categories with no budget

allowance.description: Only for the current month, and only with an income or at least one budget

isFixed.description: Rent, EMIs: money that goes anyway, held back in full from the daily allowance

current.description: Days in a row within the daily allowance, ending yesterday

description.example: 3 days in a row within your allowance

last14.description: The last 14 closed days, oldest first (missing days are absent)

badges.description: Every badge, unlocked or not, in display order

description.example: 9 am: what you can spend today

pushEnabled.description: False until push (Firebase) is set up on the server; the inbox works either way

disabledTypes.description: Types switched off; every other type is on
